deploy-bot: STARTING deploy → env: prod, service: inference-gateway, release: release-2026-03-18-1.12.0, triggered by @jamie
deploy-bot: Commits in this rollout:
- `a1b2c3d` (https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-gateway/commit/a1b2c3d) — @sarah — Fix token cache eviction
- `b2c3d4e` (https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-gateway/commit/b2c3d4e) — @chris — Bump libkv and kernel selector (PR #8421)
- `c3d4e5f` (https://github.com/redwood-inference/inference-gateway/commit/c3d4e5f) — @laura — Add metrics for batch sizing (PR #8490)
deploy-bot: Tag: `v1.12.0` pinned to `a1b2c3d` · change window: immediate · canary: 20% for 15m · SLO target p95 <200ms
jamie: Rolling canary now. watching traces and errors. If error rate >1% we rollback :eyes:
arjun: Watching dashboards. so far latency stable, small traffic spike at 02:12 likely cold starts
sarah: Heads up — `a1b2c3d` contains a kernel selector change. watch memory on p3 instances, could raise peak mem usage
laura: If mem >80% on any node, we should rollback. I'll prep a follow-up PR to tone down batch growth
chris: Noted. tagging release notes with PRs #8421 and #8490. Adding brief description for ops runbook
deploy-bot: CANARY RESULTS → sampled=200 requests · errors=10 (0.5%) · avg latency=142ms · mem usage avg=61% · action=promote to 100%
jamie: Promote approved. ramping to 100% over 5 minutes :shipit:
deploy-bot: DEPLOY COMPLETE → env: prod · release: v1.12.0 promoted by @jamie · commits included above · CI logs: https://ci.redwood.ai/builds/5678
chris: Will watch nodes for the next hour and annotate any anomalies in the incident channel
sarah: Add note in runtime docs about kernel selector behavior and recommended mem thresholds
laura: If we get any regressions we can run `/deploy rollback release:v1.12.0` — keep that command handy
jamie: Good rollout. follow-ups: add a canary memory alert to pager, update release notes with authors and PR links, and schedule a post-deploy quick sync in 1h
deploy-bot: Reminder: rollback cmd => `/deploy rollback release:v1.12.0` · created promote/rollback audit entry: https://ci.redwood.ai/audit/rollouts/8912
